mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food (id, store_id, name, price, description) VALUES (#{id}, #{storeId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE food f JOIN root r ON f.id = r.id AND r.type = 'FOOD' AND SET f.name = #{food.name}, f.price = #{food.price}, f.description = #{food.description}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE f.store_id = #{storeId} AND f.id = #{foodId}
UPDATE food f JOIN root r ON f.id = r.id AND r.type = 'FOOD' AND SET r.deleted_at = NOW() WHERE f.store_id = #{storeId} AND f.id = #{foodId}
